name: distill
description: Only what matters on the page: a focus view, an English wizard for forms in any language, and a generated layout, on-device first with Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run secret-scan && npm run check-tokens && npm run check-csp
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build -w @distill/web && npm run check:dist && node scripts/check-csp.mjs --dist && firebase deploy --only hosting --project distill-hybrid-ai --non-interactive
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-distill "npm run test:emulator -w @distill/rules-test"
